title: Sleeping Puppy - Mattress design
credits: In I had the opportunity to design two mattresses for the Australian startup Sleeping Puppy. It was a challenging project that put my skills as a designer and product developer to the test. Throughout the process there was a continuous cycle of improvement involving feedback loops with the manufacturer and Richard Liu the individual behind Sleeping Puppy who made this endeavor possible.
description: In 2023, I had the opportunity to design two mattresses for the Australian startup, Sleeping Puppy. It was a challenging project that put my skills as a designer and product developer to the test. Throughout the process, there was a continuous cycle of improvement involving feedback loops with the manufacturer and Richard Liu, the individual behind Sleeping Puppy, who made this endeavor possible.

Multiple sketches, blueprints, 3D models, prototypes, and design proposals were developed before arriving at the final product. I am delighted to have been a part of this journey. Now, the product is available for purchase throughout Australia.
Product design and development by Sebastian Medrano
Branding and web design by Juuce
Photography and videography by Bigfilm Special thanks to Richard Liu and the Sleeping Puppy team for making this possible.
